content: We must be able to stand alone before we can truly stand together.
author: Carl Jung
sourceWork: The Archetypes and the Collective Unconscious
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. Loneliness is the painful ache of feeling incomplete, while solitude is the rich discovery of your own inner presence. In a world full of constant stimulation and notifications, being alone with your thoughts can feel intimidating.

Carl Jung understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Yet silence is the only space where you can hear what your life is actually trying to say to you. When you make peace with quiet, you stop running to distractions to save you from yourself.
reflectionPrompt: How can you extend greater compassion to yourself for your own imperfections right now?
